name: Manfred von Brauchitsch
features: fair skin, dark hair, deep-set eyes, long narrow aristocratic face, prominent nose, lean build, wry resigned expression
bio: Nephew of a future Wehrmacht field marshal, Manfred von Brauchitsch was the Mercedes driver famous for losing races he had already won — a burst tyre at the Nürburgring in 1935, a burning fuel tank at Monaco in 1936. He did win the 1937 Monaco Grand Prix and outlived every rival of the Silver Arrows era, dying in 2003 at 97.
